description: This file defines interfaces and structs related to CLI command management within the framework, including command registration, service container management, and conversion to Cobra CLI commands.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: An interface representing a CLI command that can be built into a Cobra command, with methods to build the command and retrieve its name and description.

classes.name: ServiceContainer
classes.description: A container struct holding references to various service interfaces required by commands, including package, agent, dev, DID, VC, keystore services, DID registry, and storage provider.

classes.name: BaseCommand
classes.description: A struct providing common functionality for commands, holding a reference to the services container.

classes.name: CommandRegistry
classes.description: A registry managing command registration and their conversion into Cobra commands, providing methods to register commands, build Cobra commands, and retrieve all registered commands.

methods.name: NewCommandRegistry
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of CommandRegistry with an initialized command list.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Adds a Command to the CommandRegistry's list of commands.

methods.name: BuildCobraCommands
methods.description: Converts all registered Command instances into a slice of Cobra commands for CLI execution.

methods.name: GetCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of all registered Command instances.
